source_traces.admission: Leaves intentionally preserve arbitrary floats and transparent scalar/array serde; they do not claim range/finiteness policy. SurfaceMaterial public leaves, is_finite input predicate, native LinearSurfaceMaterial rejects nonfinite decoded RGB and factors. Existing Color lacks encoded authority, so reuse does not mean replacing it with a duplicate general RGBA type.
source_traces.producer_retained: Metal.color/roughness, Lacing, MailWeave, GarmentSpecification, catalog pbr, TextileColor, shared skin, component Surface payload, RiggedShell carry canonical leaves/record. Color leaf constructors used at literal/serde/actual native picker boundaries.
source_traces.operations: Srgb opaque, Srgba rgb/with_alpha preserve encoded RGB and unencoded alpha; exact old shell sRGB transfer formula now canonical. Color picker projects linear floats and writes encoded only on response.changed; roughness extracts at slider boundary.
source_traces.consumers: PassParameters ratio upload, StandardMaterial Color::srgba and raw native factor ports; LinearSurfaceMaterial for GLB/review and explicit native serialization. Hair pigment remains its separately documented linear shader/atlas numerical boundary, not falsely wrapped as encoded Srgb.

source_traces.admission: Required ArmorComponent.appearance, deny_unknown_fields and no default/fallback compatibility schema. Enum owns neighboring SurfaceMaterial/TextileAppearance payload; private primitive internals of color/ratio remain native/serde boundaries.
source_traces.producer_retained: PartLayout/Anime defaults Inherit; hardware/underlayer Surface; fastener/cord/waist/design textile clone creates sole retained recipe. device_textile_materials assigns recipe; relief updates same payload charts; skin/morph/component roles independent.
source_traces.operations: material() derives fresh scalar factors from TextileAppearance; textile_mut updates canonical recipe directly. split_textile_seams clones component payload with geometry remap; no parallel cached material/textile authority.
source_traces.consumers: Preview and runtime partitions match enum; component_materials resets inherited map/edge fields only for own material then installs current textile maps; ReviewComponent projects selected material. Inherit retains catalog fallback. Remaining physical/count/admission function contracts listed required, not automatically clear.

source_traces.owner: Creator equipment_pbr/catalog enum, Metal::appearance, Lacing::appearance, body_appearance::SKIN_APPEARANCE
source_traces.admission: Metal/Lacing/MailWeave own existing numerical policies; validated immutable Metal borrow survives baking. Catalog palette authored literal boundaries. SurfaceMaterial unbounded leaves do not invent more restrictive Bevy ranges.
source_traces.producer_retained: Metal default and catalog steel from current appearance; gilt trim uses own Metal with metallic Ratio1; cord nonmetallic; shared skin used preview/bare body/export. Catalog identity and explicit scalar appearance are distinct roles; no requirement that an authored override recompute from catalog identity inferred.
source_traces.operations: Metal uniform roughness extracts once at actual native PassParameters; bake map publication follows submit/read.
